skills.rust-release: Cut a release of a Rust crate: bump version, update CHANGELOG, tag, cargo publish, verify on crates.io
skills.etl-verify: Verify a data stream through the ETL pipeline: run deterministic stage checks (PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE) from raw landing to warehouse tables
skills.aws-ssm-connect: Connect to hardened AWS hosts through SSM Session Manager with the right profile, region and port forwarding; avoids the bastion pitfalls
skills.contract-negotiation: Prepare and track a data contract with another team: schema proposal, field-level SLAs, open questions, sign-off log
skills.postgres-migration: Write and apply a Postgres schema migration safely: lock timeouts, backfill in batches, verify row counts, rollback plan
skills.playwright-e2e: Verify a web UI by running Playwright end-to-end tests through the main user workflows and reading the trace on failure
skills.docker-debug: Debug a container that fails to start: inspect logs, entrypoint, env, healthcheck, exec into a shell
skills.git-bisect: Find the commit that introduced a regression with git bisect run and a deterministic test script
skills.flaky-test-triage: Triage a flaky test: rerun in a loop, capture seeds and timing, isolate shared state, quarantine or fix
skills.k8s-rollout: Roll out a new image to Kubernetes, watch the rollout, check pod health, and roll back on failure
skills.python-env: Set up or repair a Python project environment with uv: venv, lockfile, interpreter version, editable installs
skills.incident-postmortem: Write a blameless postmortem: timeline from logs, impact, root cause, action items
skills.terraform-plan: Plan and apply Terraform changes safely: fmt, validate, plan to file, review destroys, apply the saved plan
skills.perf-profile: Profile a slow program: flamegraph with perf/samply, find the hot path, benchmark before and after
